stellen-verb-3ddeeb2a.fix: To ask a question or make a demand (used with nouns like 'Frage' or 'Bedingung'). | to ask, to pose, to make

a-veces-adv-566ce858.quote: Used to express that an action happens occasionally but not always.

amar-verb-953e673e.quote: Ella dice que ama bailar los fines de semana.

dar-verb-7cb7de0d.fix: To cause or produce a feeling, sensation, or effect in someone. | give, make feel, cause

dar-verb-7cb7de0d.fix: 'Dar' is irregular in the first-person singular present ('doy') and takes regular -er/-ir endings in the preterite ('di', 'diste', 'dio'...).
dar-verb-7cb7de0d.why: A1/A2 learners plainly need to know that 'dar' is irregular in the present and preterite.

debil-adj-3af279b9.quote: Se escuchaba una débil luz al fondo del pasillo.

spring-noun-5b622de6.fix: Lugar donde el agua brota de la tierra de forma natural. | manantial, fuente

tall-adj-9bc90422.quote: De un objeto que tiene una gran extensión vertical.

noun-f29d6dec.quote: In Russian culture, the uzhin is typically the main meal of the day
noun-f29d6dec.fix: In Russian culture, 'ужин' is the evening meal, while 'обед' (midday meal) is traditionally the largest meal of the day.
noun-f29d6dec.why: Traditionally in Russia, 'обед' is the main meal of the day, not 'ужин'.

verb-0851f175.fix: Он всегда берёт книги из этой библиотеки.
verb-0851f175.why: Uses the perfective partner 'взять' instead of the headword 'брать'.

verb-0851f175.quote: He took the book from the table.
verb-0851f175.fix: He always takes books from this library.
verb-0851f175.why: Update translation to match the corrected imperfective example.

verb-0851f175.quote: Мы решили взять машину напрокат на выходные.
verb-0851f175.fix: Летом мы обычно берём машину напрокат.
verb-0851f175.why: Uses the perfective partner 'взять' instead of the headword 'брать'.

verb-0851f175.quote: We decided to rent a car for the weekend.
verb-0851f175.fix: In the summer we usually rent a car.
verb-0851f175.why: Update translation to match the corrected imperfective example.

verb-0851f175.fix: 'брать' has an irregular present-tense stem with a fleeting vowel: я беру́, ты берёшь, они беру́т.
verb-0851f175.why: A2 learners need the irregular stem change (бр- -> бер-) in the present tense.

verb-62298af6.quote: This verb describes carrying something by holding it or wearing it as you move somewhere.
verb-62298af6.fix: 'нести' is a unidirectional verb of motion (carrying in one direction right now); its multidirectional partner is 'носить', and its perfective is 'понести'.
verb-62298af6.why: Restates the definition and misses the crucial unidirectional vs. multidirectional distinction ('носить').

verb-ac9e5c2f.quote: Followed immediately by the instrumental case (in Russian, nouns take the ending -е or -ой).
verb-ac9e5c2f.fix: Followed by the preposition 'в' (or 'во') plus the prepositional case (e.g., нуждаться в помощи — to need help).
verb-ac9e5c2f.why: 'нуждаться' takes 'в' + prepositional case, not the instrumental case.

bakmak-verb-3fe06595.why: First k is voiceless /k/, not voiced /ɡ/, and stress is final.

bakmak-verb-3fe06595.quote: Bakmak is a very versatile verb. While its primary meaning is to look, it is
bakmak-verb-3fe06595.fix: Bakmak takes the dative case (-e/-a) for the object being looked at or cared for (e.g., bana bak — look at me).
bakmak-verb-3fe06595.why: Restates the senses; should instead explain that bakmak governs the dative case.

uyumak-verb-56fff049.quote: To remain inactive, dormant, or unresponsive.
uyumak-verb-56fff049.why: Figurative/idiomatic sense ('to slack off / be asleep at the wheel') not needed at A2.

uyumak-verb-56fff049.quote: Proje üzerinde çalışanlar biraz uyudu ama şimdi tekrar hızlandılar.
uyumak-verb-56fff049.why: Unnatural Turkish; also contradicts note[0] which says this sense is for mechanisms/systems.
Remove marginal second sense from shortGloss.

uyumak-verb-56fff049.quote: Uyumak is the standard verb for sleeping, but it can also describe mechanisms or systems
uyumak-verb-56fff049.why: Restates the gloss and makes a false claim about mechanisms/systems.

verb-843f487d.quote: to eat; to drink; to suffer
verb-843f487d.fix: to eat; to take; to suffer
verb-843f487d.why: In modern standard Mandarin, 吃 does not generally mean 'to drink'.

verb-843f487d.quote: Besides food, 吃 is used for drinks that involve a spoon or are considered meals, like 吃药 (take medicine) or 吃面 (eat noodles).
verb-843f487d.fix: Besides food, 吃 is also used for taking medicine, as in 吃药 (take medicine).
verb-843f487d.why: Medicine and noodles are not drinks; soup (汤) uses 喝, not 吃, in standard Mandarin.

verb-843f487d.quote: To consume a liquid or take medication.
verb-843f487d.why: In standard Mandarin, consuming liquids uses 喝; 吃 is used for solid/liquid medicine (吃药).

noun-8c1fb7b7.fix: Has a fleeting vowel (е) that drops in declined forms: незнако́мца, незнако́мцу, etc.
noun-8c1fb7b7.why: Learners need to know about the fleeting vowel in declension.

noun-91420c9c.why: Unstressed 'о' in the first pretonic syllable reduces to [ɐ], not [a].

noun-91420c9c.quote: Used specifically for the institution where people receive medical treatment and stay in beds.
noun-91420c9c.why: merely restates the definition of a hospital.

noun-980d1ea3.why: Broad transcription of Russian uses /o/ rather than /ɵ/.

noun-c32f2ada.quote: In Russian, 'море' refers specifically to the sea. Be careful not to confuse it
noun-c32f2ada.fix: Takes the preposition на (not в) for going to or being at the seaside: поехать на море, отдыхать на море.
noun-c32f2ada.why: Restates the gloss; learners actually need to know it takes 'на' for the seaside.

noun-c32f2ada.quote: Metaphorically, 'море' can be used to describe a vast quantity of something, for example,
noun-c32f2ada.fix: In the sense of 'a lot of', it is followed by a noun in the genitive case: море работы (a sea of work).
noun-c32f2ada.why: Restates sense 1 without adding the grammar point (takes genitive).

noun-d65f1aed.quote: Used for both physical pain and emotional suffering.
noun-d65f1aed.fix: Feminine third-declension noun ending in a soft sign (-ь); genitive/dative/prepositional singular is бо́ли.
noun-d65f1aed.why: Merely restates the two senses; a note on its -ь declension is more useful.

rico-adj-44bbcf17.quote: Do not confuse this with 'rico' in a social context, which can sometimes imply
rico-adj-44bbcf17.why: Warns not to confuse the word with itself, and mentions an unlisted sense.
'Rich' is the more common everyday translation and should come first.

tarde-adv-d70fcb11.why: 'In the afternoon' is not in the senses (and requires 'por la tarde').

tarde-adv-d70fcb11.quote: Used as an adverb meaning 'late', as in 'Llego tarde' (I am arriving late).
tarde-adv-d70fcb11.fix: Do not confuse with the feminine noun 'la tarde' (the afternoon / evening).
tarde-adv-d70fcb11.why: Only restates the part of speech and gloss; should contrast with the noun 'la tarde'.
